summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall='node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xXXXX names with wrapper-object string/call indirection) and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the binary, then execFileSyncs it against a shipped 727KB single-line file math_init.js. math_init.js carries a '// @bun @bun-cjs' header, a large numeric constant array, and a string-array rotation decoder (function shifting/pushing an array of hex constants) — an opaque compiled Bun bundle. The package advertises itself as a React UI component library, which has no purpose-aligned reason to fetch a second language runtime or execute a compiled Bun bundle at install time. The combination — obfuscated preinstall script fetching an alternate runtime and using it to run an obfuscated in-tree payload automatically on npm install — is an install-time arbitrary-code-execution vector on the installer host, and the alien-runtime execution path bypasses Node/npm-focused scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
